mapper.sql: select w.wrk_id as workId, w.wrk_resume_id as resumeId, year(w.wrk_start_date) * 12 + month(w.wrk_start_date) as startMonth, year(case when w.wrk_is_current = 1 then curdate() else least(w.wrk_end_date, curdate()) end) * 12 + month(case when w.wrk_is_current = 1 then curdate() else least(w.wrk_end_date, curdate()) end) as endMonth from t_res_work w where w.wrk_start_date is not null and w.wrk_start_date <= curdate() and (w.wrk_is_current = 1 or (w.wrk_end_date is not null and w.wrk_end_date >= w.wrk_start_date))
mapper.select:
select distinct
trim(u.current_city) trim(u.target_city)
from t_tal t join sys_user u on u.user_id = t.tal_user_id where t.tal_company_id = #{companyId}
and nullif(trim(u.current_city), '') is not null and nullif(trim(u.target_city), '') is not null
order by 1

select distinct r.rbs_job_direction from t_tal t join t_res_base r on r.rbs_id = t.tal_resume_id where t.tal_company_id = #{companyId} and r.rbs_job_direction is not null and r.rbs_job_direction != '' order by r.rbs_job_direction
select distinct tg.tg_name from t_tal_tag tg join t_tal t on t.tal_id = tg.tg_candidate_id where t.tal_company_id = #{companyId} order by tg.tg_name
mapper.update: update t_tal set tal_archive_source = #{archiveSource} where tal_id = #{talId}
mapper.select: select p.pos_id as positionId, p.pos_title as positionName, p.pos_work_city as city, count(distinct t.tal_id) as pendingCount from t_pos p join t_app_record a on a.app_position_id = p.pos_id join t_tal t on t.tal_id = a.app_candidate_id where p.pos_company_id = #{companyId} and a.app_status = 0 group by p.pos_id, p.pos_title, p.pos_work_city order by pendingCount desc, p.pos_id desc

select p.pos_id as positionId, p.pos_title as positionName from t_pos p where p.pos_company_id = #{companyId} and exists (select 1 from t_app_record a where a.app_position_id = p.pos_id) order by p.pos_id desc

select count(distinct t.tal_id) from t_app_record a join t_pos p on p.pos_id = a.app_position_id join t_tal t on t.tal_id = a.app_candidate_id where p.pos_company_id = #{companyId} and a.app_status = 0

select a.app_id as applicationId, t.tal_id as talentId, a.app_position_id as positionId, p.pos_title as positionName, date_format(a.app_created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') as appliedAt, u.nick_name as name, u.phonenumber as phone, r.rbs_job_direction as jobDirection from t_app_record a join t_pos p on p.pos_id = a.app_position_id join t_tal t on t.tal_id = a.app_candidate_id left join sys_user u on u.user_id = t.tal_user_id left join t_res_base r on r.rbs_id = a.app_resume_id where p.pos_company_id = #{companyId} and a.app_status = 0
and a.app_position_id = #{positionId}
and (u.nick_name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or u.phonenumber like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
order by a.app_created_at desc, a.app_id desc
select pos_id from t_pos where pos_id = #{positionId} and pos_company_id = #{companyId}
select pos_id from t_pos where pos_id = #{positionId} and pos_company_id = #{companyId} limit 1
select app_id from t_app_record where app_candidate_id = #{talId} and app_position_id = #{positionId} limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into t_app_record (app_candidate_id, app_position_id, app_resume_id, app_status) values (#{talId}, #{positionId}, #{resumeId}, 0)
insert into t_msg (msg_receiver_id, msg_sender_id, msg_type, msg_title, msg_content, msg_is_read) values (#{receiverId}, 0, 1, #{title}, #{content}, 0)
mapper.select: select t.tal_id as talentId, t.tal_status as status, t.tal_matched_score as matchedScore, t.tal_current_round as currentRound, t.tal_resume_id as resumeId, u.user_id as userId, u.nick_name as name, u.phonenumber as phone, u.email as email, r.rbs_resume_name as resumeName, r.rbs_job_direction as jobDirection from t_tal t left join sys_user u on u.user_id = t.tal_user_id left join t_res_base r on r.rbs_id = t.tal_resume_id where t.tal_id = #{talId} and t.tal_company_id = #{companyId}
select tg_name as name, tg_source as source from t_tal_tag where tg_candidate_id = #{talId} order by tg_id

select edu_school as school, edu_major as major, edu_degree as degree, date_format(edu_start_date, '%Y-%m') as startDate, date_format(edu_end_date, '%Y-%m') as endDate from t_res_education where edu_resume_id = #{resumeId} order by edu_end_date desc

select wrk_company as company, wrk_position as position, date_format(wrk_start_date, '%Y-%m') as startDate, case when wrk_is_current = 1 then '至今' else date_format(wrk_end_date, '%Y-%m') end as endDate, wrk_description as summary from t_res_work where wrk_resume_id = #{resumeId} order by wrk_start_date desc
select prj_name as name, prj_role as role, prj_tech_stack as techStack, prj_description as summary from t_res_project where prj_resume_id = #{resumeId} order by prj_start_date desc
select skl_name as name, skl_level as level from t_res_skill where skl_resume_id = #{resumeId} order by skl_level desc, skl_id
select count(*) from t_res_education where edu_resume_id = #{resumeId}
select count(*) from t_res_work where wrk_resume_id = #{resumeId}
select count(*) from t_res_project where prj_resume_id = #{resumeId}
select count(*) from t_res_skill where skl_resume_id = #{resumeId}
